//: Phase 9 names 'Three.js + TypeScript' as the implementation stack. This project
type-checks with TypeScript but EMITS NOTHING (noEmit), so the ES modules the
browser loads through the importmap stay byte-identical to the modules the Node
test suite verifies. ARCHITECTURE.md records that as a deliberate invariant: a
build step would create a second artifact that could drift from the tested one.
Types are expressed in JSDoc and checked with checkJs, so TypeScript's checker
and TypeScript's strictness both apply to every source file.
//include: The GATE covers src/ only, and src/ is clean at zero diagnostics.
Tests are enforced by node --test. They deliberately pass wrong-typed and
malformed inputs to prove runtime guards reject them, so presenting strict
static analysis of the test fixtures as a supported command would be misleading.
